title: Schneider Electric Conext ComBox
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW RESOURCE EXHAUSTION CWE-400 A series of rapid requests to the device may cause it to reboot. CVE-2017-6019 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.5 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ). RESEARCHER Arik Kublanov and Mark Liapustin of Nation-E Ltd reported this vulnerability. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sector: Energy Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: Paris, France   This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
